fact: The World Bank aide memoire for the mission of 20 October to 1 November 2024 says the HISWA project supports administrative statistics through the Annual Statistical Digest, whose data collection was completed, and recommends a consultant for analysis and report production; no digest edition is shown published.
title: Sierra Leone Harmonizing and Improving Statistics in West Africa (HISWA) Project P169265 - IDA Grant D5840 Implementation Support Mission October 20 to November 1, 2024 Aide Memoire
